nameCheck.why: Tecolutla is a Veracruz municipality, and Thai atlases would likely render Spanish "co" as "โก" but the "te" as "เต" is fine; the issue is that the name lacks a region-kind word like "เทศบาล" and the standard Thai transliteration is uncertain, so "เตโกลุตลา" is plausible but unverified.
